issues.title: Assets disappear from map when new orders sent
issues.body:
*I had two tabs open (one logged in as Blue Sub-Surface and the other as red Land & Fires).
*In both I had expanded own forces to show 2,000.
*In each I had expanded other forces to show 2,000 and then filtered to not show green.
*In both, on own forces, I had filtered the unit selection to only show ISTAR.
*I then selected a Red ISTAR asset, selected Air-ISTAR from the orders selection, plotted fairly generic and non-overlapping routes/polygons as required.
*When the orders template popped open I called it 'Red ISTAR I', set the start time to 1st May 12:05, and the end time to 3rd May 12:05.
*I then hit submit and *poof*.
